review_comment: The code directly uses user-provided input in a URL context without validation, creating an open redirect vulnerability. The smart_urlquote() function only encodes special characters but does not validate the URL scheme or domain. A malicious actor could provide a URL with a different scheme (e.g., javascript:, mailto:, or http://evil.com) that would be rendered as a clickable link, potentially leading to phishing attacks or redirection to malicious sites. Implement URL validation against a whitelist of trusted domains before allowing user-provided URLs to be rendered in HTML anchor tags.
